name: ng-checkup-vscode
description: ng-checkup findings inline: deprecated APIs, zoneless readiness, signals adoption, type safety and circular dependencies of your Angular codebase in the Problems panel, with the modernization score in the status bar.
author: Stefan Kuburovic

untrustedWorkspaces.description: ng-checkup reads the workspace files and its package metadata; it runs only in trusted workspaces.

ng-checkup.registryLookup.markdownDescription: Ask the npm registry for the latest Angular version and for the metadata of installed packages that depend on Angular. Off by default: then nothing leaves the machine and the version check compares against the newest major the bundled ng-checkup knows. `"offline": true` in `ng-checkup.config.json` wins over this setting.

enumDescriptions: High findings show as warnings: they are modernization debt, not compile errors.
High findings show as errors, to match a CI gate that fails on them.
ng-checkup.highSeverity.description: How findings of high severity show in the editor. Medium findings are warnings, low ones information.

ng-checkup.maxExamples.description: How many locations each finding lists. The CLI shows 5 by default; the editor wants all of them.

ng-checkup.runOnSave.description: Analyse again after a TypeScript file, a template, package.json, a tsconfig or ng-checkup.config.json is saved.

ng-checkup.debounceMs.description: How long to wait after the last save before analysing, in milliseconds. Saves during a run are folded into one follow-up run.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:production
